dialogues.speaker: Masrur
dialogues.text: Welcome to Port Ormos. Please register your ship here.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Even if my ship is small?

dialogues.speaker: Masrur
dialogues.text: Theoretically, we need crew info and reason for visit for all docking ships.

dialogues.speaker: Masrur
dialogues.text: Especially when it comes to trading.

dialogues.speaker: Masrur
dialogues.text: Unregistered ships doing business in Port Ormos will be curtailed and penalized.

dialogues.speaker: Masrur
dialogues.text: Port Ormos is the biggest port in Sumeru, and a key hub for trading.

dialogues.speaker: Masrur
dialogues.text: It's not as big as Liyue Harbor, but it still sees considerable traffic daily.

dialogues.speaker: Masrur
dialogues.text: So we'd like every ship to comply with the Navbed and continue Sumeru's prosperity.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: I'll leave you to it, then.
